name: Kishi Minarai to Muramusume
source:
A monochrome action RPG in the style of old-school games.

When disaster suddenly strikes a mountain village, a squire and a village girl are caught up in a fight to survive. The player controls the squire, relying on his sword, items and stealth rather than brute force, while the girl follows on her own and responds only to simple commands ("Come!", "Stop!"). The player's actions and choices change the characters' fates, leading to several endings.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01720376.html]DLsite[/url].]
